requirements.research_statement: Yandex Search is designed to solve the user's task using relevant/useful information; query and page evidence matter more than keyword wording alone.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Describe the ordinary-Search task from persisted Yandex Search evidence for the exact query, including dominant page type/format/angle and commercial/informational/procedural/comparison orientation.
requirements.failure_policy: If the saved Search baseline is missing, stale or contradictory enough to block a verdict, mark evidence gap and do not invent a task; a fresh request needs separate information-gain justification and owner authorization.
requirements.claim_boundary: Intent structure is an analyst description of observed Yandex results, not a provider-native intent label.
requirements.qa_check: 8/8 cases have explicit Search evidence refs; no query-wording-only intent inference where saved results exist.
requirements.acceptance_check: ordinary Search side complete for 8/8 cases

requirements.research_statement: GenSearch exposes message, sources with used flags, and refined searchQueries; used=true means the document was used in the answer.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Read corrected Step-16 authority plus raw verbatim evidence and describe the GenSearch exact-query task/orientation, refined queries and used sources.
requirements.failure_policy: Missing/ambiguous evidence maps to INSUFFICIENT, not fabricated provider facts.
requirements.claim_boundary: GenSearch-specific observation only; not consumer Alice or Webmaster Alice visibility.
requirements.qa_check: 8/8 cases trace to STEP_16_OBSERVATIONS_CORRECTED_V2 and authoritative raw files.

requirements.research_statement: The executed dataset is exact-query GenSearch evidence and must not be expanded into broad user-job-family or cross-platform AI claims.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Scope each comparison verdict to the exact tested query/evidence family; keep GenSearch separate from unobserved AI surfaces.
requirements.failure_policy: Any broad user-job or generic Alice claim fails QA.
requirements.claim_boundary: one exact query != every natural formulation of the user job; GenSearch != generic AI visibility

requirements.research_statement: Source links are not ranked by display order; a URL/title alone is insufficient for a material page-role claim.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Open/read the current used=true page whenever a verdict materially depends on classifying it as service/product/DIY/comparison/specialist/broad/etc.
requirements.failure_policy: If a required source cannot be read, set role unresolved and do not use it decisively; verdict may become INSUFFICIENT.
requirements.claim_boundary: URL/title role is descriptive hint only until direct validation when material.
requirements.acceptance_check: every material source-role inference has direct evidence

requirements.research_statement: GenSearch documents used flags but no source importance weight; Yandex says Alice source links are not ranked by link order.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Preserve source identity/role/used status; never treat array position or used-source count as rank/weight.
requirements.failure_policy: Any rank/weight inference from order/count blocks acceptance.
requirements.claim_boundary: source order/count does not prove importance

requirements.research_statement: Generative answers/source composition can vary; evaluation should preserve conditions and uncertainty.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Record reproducibility state for every case. A material architecture-changing contradiction driven only by one GenSearch snapshot cannot receive final CHANGE.
requirements.availability_or_access_state: EXISTING EVIDENCE: 7 SINGLE-RUN CASES; C15-010 TWO SHORT-WINDOW RUNS
requirements.provider_or_tool_capability_state: NO NEW CALL REQUIRED BY DEFAULT
requirements.cost_or_quota_boundary: any new paid repeat requires owner authorization
requirements.failure_policy: Unreproduced AI-only material conflict -> INSUFFICIENT unless a qualifying independent evidence route resolves the same decision without relying on stochastic AI persistence.
requirements.acceptance_check: all CHANGE verdicts pass reproducibility/evidence-strength gate

requirements.research_statement: Project taxonomy for Search-vs-AI material delta is CHANGE / DE_RISK / NO_CHANGE / INSUFFICIENT and CHANGE must not be forced.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Assign exactly one final Step-17 verdict to every case after fixed-axis comparison.
requirements.failure_policy: Ambiguity remains INSUFFICIENT rather than being forced to CHANGE/NO_CHANGE.
requirements.claim_boundary: taxonomy is project-specific, not Yandex standard

requirements.research_statement: Step 14 already froze a Search-only architecture; Step 18 is prioritization, so Step 17 must compare and materialize only AI-derived changes to that frozen baseline rather than rebuilding the whole site architecture.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: For each CHANGE verdict, record affected Step-14 unit/page, baseline state, proposed AI-derived delta, evidence and coherence recheck requirement. All non-CHANGE units inherit Step 14 unchanged.
requirements.failure_policy: No full architecture rebuild or prioritization inside Step 17.
requirements.claim_boundary: Step17 overlay is bounded to AI-tested cases; Step18 owns prioritization.

requirements.research_statement: Fresh provider calls require explicit unresolved question, information gain, cost/retry/persistence and acceptance use.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Reuse persisted same-day evidence. Do not launch new Search or GenSearch unless a blocking gap is documented and owner authorizes the exact request.
requirements.required_artifact_field_or_output: fresh_request_needed=false by default; request_justification if triggered
requirements.provider_or_tool_capability_state: PROVIDER AVAILABLE BUT NOT NEEDED BY DEFAULT

requirements.research_statement: Industry SERP analysis commonly describes dominant content type, format and angle to understand observed search intent.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Use type/format/angle as descriptive fields over Yandex evidence, not as externally mandated Yandex labels.
requirements.failure_policy: Do not present 3Cs as Yandex standard.

requirements.research_statement: Owned Alice visibility is a distinct Webmaster surface and is unavailable in this job.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Record route as unavailable/not executed; do not infer SoV or real owned Alice visibility.
requirements.failure_policy: Base Step17 can continue; corresponding claims remain forbidden.
requirements.claim_boundary: no owned Alice visibility, SoV or historical Alice-source claim

requirements.research_statement: Step completion requires complete case accounting, reverse trace, independent/adversarial QA and readback; technical activity alone is not completion.
requirements.required_action_or_collection: Run 8/8 case completeness QA, missing-evidence QA, claim-boundary QA, delta-overlay QA and GitHub readback before completion.
requirements.failure_policy: Any blocking finding keeps Step17 incomplete and blocks Step18.
requirements.claim_boundary: completion only after required output exists and is verified
